faq.1.a: Yes. The source photo guides the work: walls, openings, floors, perspective and volumes are preserved. Every image is checked and you approve it before any publication. A non-compliant image is adjusted or discarded.
faq.2.a: 2 to 3 business days as a guide, after approval of the photos and brief. Timing depends on volume and complexity and is confirmed in the quote.
faq.3.a: Each offer includes one round of adjustments within the approved brief (one round per batch for the Partner agency offer). A complete change of direction is quoted separately.
faq.4.a: One JPG, PNG or WebP photo up to 10 MB via the form, or a download link for several photos. A sharp, bright photo works best: if a photo is too dark, blurry or cluttered, we tell you before we start.
faq.5.a: Add a visible “Virtually staged” (or “Renovation simulation”) label to the listing and the images. The furniture and decoration are virtual and not included in the sale. Keep the original photo too, where possible.
faq.5.q: How do I label virtual staging in a listing?
faq.6.a: One free photo per new agency, with no commitment and no charge. Send your photo and your goal: we confirm whether it can be processed.
faq.6.q: How does the free trial work?
faq.7.a: The authorised media and the scope of rights are set out in the quote. You must hold the rights to the photos you send.
faq.8.a: They are short edits (15 to 30 seconds) from your photos, with a vertical version. They are not filmed tours, and any virtual staging stays clearly labelled.
faq.title: Your questions. Our answers.
faqp.1.a: No. Everything is produced remotely from the photos, videos and materials you send, and generated with artificial intelligence.
faqp.1.q: Are the videos filmed on site?
faqp.2.a: The generated images are advertising creations. Visual features (colour, wheels, options, product details) are checked against your photos, and every shot is submitted for your approval before delivery.
faqp.2.q: Is the vehicle or product shown accurate?
faqp.3.a: Vertical 9:16 for TikTok, Reels and Shorts, horizontal 16:9 for your website and YouTube, square 1:1 for social media. The formats included depend on the offer and are confirmed in the quote.
faqp.4.a: No. They are AI-generated and used as an advertising format, never to fake a review or customer testimonial.
faqp.4.q: Are the UGC avatars real people?
faqp.5.a: Add a photo directly in the form, or a download link for a batch. If needed, we explain how to send us your files after your request.
faqp.5.q: How do I send my photos?
faqp.6.a: Yes, especially for garages and dealerships with several vehicles: volume, pace and formats are defined together, then confirmed in the quote.
faqp.title: What you need to know.
